subject: Forecast gaps bounty — confirm missing fields for Q4 commitments
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast gaps bounty — confirm missing fields for Q4 commitments

Team,

Quick one — finance asked for a sweep of high-ARR opportunities for Q4 to ensure our forecast is actionable before close-of-business next Friday (09/15). I pulled a report and there are ~42 deals with at least one of the following missing or clearly incorrect:

- Amount (ARR/TCV mismatch)
- Product/SKU (blank or generic "Custom")
- Next step (empty or stale)
- Probability not updated to reflect current stage

I attached gaps_report_Q4.csv with the top 42 by ARR. My ask: please take ownership of your deals in the list and update CRM fields by EOD 09/13 so revenue ops can certify the commit.

To make this less painful, we are running a small "gaps bounty": whoever clears the largest net ARR (validated by RevOps) gets a shoutout in the revenue all-hands and first dibs on the new headphones from CapEx. Not meant to be punitive — we just need accurate signals for the board update.

Process checklist (short):
1) Confirm Amount matches signed SOW or your negotiation note.
2) Map the product to an SKUs listed in sku_map_v2 (I will attach v2 after clarifications).
3) Set explicit next step and expected close date (MM/DD).
4) Update probability to one of: 10/30/60/80/95/100 depending on gating items.

Drop any ambiguous cases to this thread and tag RevOps (laura.bennett@redwood.com) so they can adjudicate.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

> Quick one — finance asked for a sweep of high-ARR opportunities for Q4 to ensure our forecast is actionable before close-of-business next Friday (09/15).

I'll start annotating notes in CRM and ping legal if we need countersigned copies.

—Ben
Senior Account Executive

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmeproducts.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Sep 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast gaps bounty — confirm missing fields for Q4 commitments

Hi Ben / Marcus,

Thanks for the heads up — appreciate the transparency. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- For 2 deals (Acme-Edu & Acme-Cloud), we have a PO for Acme-Cloud but Acme-Edu is still in legal review. We can treat PO as firm for Acme-Cloud.
- SKUs: we use product codes from our procurement portal (example: ACME-PLAT-STD). Can you share your SKU mapping?
- Next step: Raj (cc) will confirm internal budget sign-off by 09/14.

If it helps, I can forward the PO and procurement code export.

Thanks,
Emma
Procurement Manager, Acme Products

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acmeproducts.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acmeproducts.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Sep 2028 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast gaps bounty — confirm missing fields for Q4 commitments

Emma — perfect, thanks for the quick reply.

Answers inline and next steps:

- Treat PO as the amount source if it's an unconditional PO (no pending budget approvals attached). Ben — mark Amount = PO amount and flag notes field with link to PO scan.
- SKU mapping: attaching sku_map_v2.xlsx (canonical mapping we use internally). If any procurement codes don't map 1:1, reply with the Acme code and we'll add a mapping row.
- Raj — thanks for the expected 09/14 budget confirmation. If you can confirm by EOD 09/14 we will leave the deals in Commit for Q4; otherwise RevOps will move them to Best Case on 09/15 close.

Attachments: sku_map_v2.xlsx (SKU mapping table)

RevOps notes: Laura, feel free to ingest PO scans to support Ben's amount updates — I flagged the CSV rows where this is the case.

Marcus

---
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Strategy

Thanks all — small reminder on process: if a deal owner does not respond or cannot provide documentation by 09/14, move the deal to "Best Case" and update the probability according to stage guidance (Sales Ops playbook page 3).

Two quick asks for Ben:
- Please attach PO scans to the CRM record and add the procurement code to the Product SKU custom field.
- Add a one-line rationale in the notes for any probability increases >15 points.

We'll reconcile the final certified commit list on 09/15 at 10:00AM in the Revenue Ops channel (calendar invite to follow).

Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
